text: I don't find the time to work out. I MAKE time to work out.
No, I won't SKIP my workout.
It doesn't matter if I feel like working out. All that matters is I DO IT ANYWAY.
Go the EXTRA MILE... it's never crowded there.
The next 6 months are going to pass whether you LIFT WEIGHTS OR NOT.
You get the body you WORK FOR, whether you want it or not.
One hour three times per week in the gym is NO COUNTERBALANCE to all of the other behavior in those other 165 HOURS.
author: Mark Twight

text: There are NO SHORTCUTS. It takes time to build a BETTER & STRONGER VERSION OF YOURSELF.
CIVILIZE THE MIND but make SAVAGE THE BODY.
author: Ancient Chinese Proverb

text: It is a shame for a man to grow old without seeing the BEAUTY and STRENGTH of which his body is capable.
author: Socrates

text: Relish the challenge of overcoming difficulties that would CRUSH ORDINARY MEN... learn to SUFFER.
author: Mark Twight

text: ...don't listen to the lies, your BARRIERS ARE BREAKABLE.
STOP DOUBTING YOURSELF. Work HARD and make it happen.
I lift things up and PUT THEM DOWN.
One of the greatest pleasures in life is realizing that two weeks ago your body couldn't do WHAT IT JUST DID.
The 80/10/10 rule. 80% of your workouts will go just fine, 10% of them you'll absolutely CRUSH, and the other 10% of them, well, there's always tomorrow :0)
